title: Binance Futures Launches New Listings Fee Promotion: Enjoy 0 Maker Fee and Enhanced Maker Rebates
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, As part of our commitment to building a more accessible, liquid, and user-friendly derivatives market, Binance is introducing a new fee promotion for eligible, newly-listed USDT-margined perpetual contracts. During the first 10 days of each new contract’s launch (Incentive Period), all users can enjoy 0 maker fees, while all qualified liquidity providers will benefit from higher maker rebates. This initiative is designed to improve trading conditions for retail users and enhance market depth at the early stage of each listing. Validity Period:  2025-07-25 00:00 (UTC) to 2026-01-16 23:59 (UTC) Promotion Fee Structure: User Type Fee Type Rate Period All Users Maker Fee 0% Contract launch day is considered Day 0. Fee promotion starts at Day 0 launch time and lasts until Day 9 at 23:59 (UTC) (hereinafter referred to as “Incentive Period”). USDT-margined Futures Liquidity Providers Maker Fee  -0.006% (-0.6 bps) Incentive Period All Users Taker Fee Standard per VIP Level Fee Rate N/A Example: How the Incentive Period Works If a new USDT-margined perpetual contract is listed at 2025-07-25 09:00 (UTC) (Day 0): The Incentive Period starts at 2025-07-25 09:00 (UTC) It ends at 2025-08-03 23:59 (UTC) (Day 9) During this Incentive Period: All users enjoy 0 maker fees when trading the new contract. Qualified liquidity providers (regardless of tiers) can receive enhanced -0.006% (-0.6bps) maker fees. After 2025-08-03 23:59 (UTC), standard fee rates based on VIP level / liquidity provider tier will apply. How to Participate in the Binance Futures Liquidity Provider Program: Users who have a minimum Futures trading volume of  $100,000,000 equivalent  or a minimum Spot trading volume of  $20,000,000 equivalent  over a 30-day period on Binance or other platforms may apply for this program.  Successful applicants will be eligible for a four-week grace period, where they will be granted  Tier 2  maker fee rebates on USDT-Margined Futures Contracts, and be exempt from weekly reviews.  To apply for this program, please provide proof of your trading volume to  mmprogram@binance.com  or contact your  sales or key account coverage team . Please Note: Binance Futures will announce new USDT-margined futures perpetual contracts that are eligible for the Promotion in the corresponding listing announcement. Liquidity providers that newly qualify during the Incentive Period of a new eligible USDT-margined perpetual contract will  not  receive the promotional maker fee rebate for trades on that contract under the Promotion.  Only liquidity providers who are already qualified at the time of the contract listing will automatically receive the rebate benefit. Sub-accounts created during the Incentive Period of a new eligible USDT-margined perpetual contract will  not  be eligible for the promotional fee rate on that contract. The promotional fee rate applies only to sub-accounts that exist at the time of the initial listing. When the Incentive Period ends, the fee rates will revert to standard levels. There may be a short period where liquidity providers receive higher-than-standard maker rebates due to timing of the fee reset. This is expected and part of the normal adjustment cycle. All trading volumes and metrics related to the Promotion are measured by Binance at its sole and absolute discretion. Self trades will be excluded from volume calculations. Binance reserves the right to, at its sole discretion, remove accounts from the Promotion. Binance reserves the right to amend or terminate this Promotion or Promotion rules at its sole discretion. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-07-24 Note: This announcement was updated on 2025-10-27 to amend the validity period.
